questions.question: (1)/(20) { is what percentage of } (10)/(60) ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Required Percentage = (Target Value ÷ Base Value) × 100

⇒ Required Percentage = [(1/20) ÷ (10/60)] × 100

⇒ Required Percentage = (1/20) × (60/10) × 100

⇒ Required Percentage = (3/10) × 100

⇒ Required Percentage = 30%

**∴ The correct answer is 30%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Target value = 1/20

Base value = 10/60

Percentage = (Target Value ÷ Base Value) × 100

 
 Base = 10/60 = 1/6
 100%

 
 Target = 1/20
 30%

 
•

• 

 Percentage = (1/20) ÷ (1/6) × 100 = 30%

**Calculations:**

⇒ Base value = 10/60 = 1/6

⇒ Percentage = (1/20) ÷ (1/6) × 100

⇒ Percentage = (1/20) × 6 × 100

⇒ Percentage = (6/20) × 100

⇒ Percentage = 6 × 5

A is what percentage of B?

Formula: (A ÷ B) × 100. It compares the target value A with the base value B and expresses the ratio out of 100.

To convert any simplified fraction a/b to a percentage, multiply it directly by 100. For example, 1/5 × 100 = 20%.

questions.question: If 646 bananas were distributed among three monkeys in the ratio (1)/(6): (1)/(9) : (1)/(4) how many bananas did the first monkey get?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Simplify the given fraction ratio by multiplying with their LCM (6, 9, 4) = 36.

New ratio = (1/6 × 36) : (1/9 × 36) : (1/4 × 36) = 6 : 4 : 9.

Total parts = 6 + 4 + 9 = 19 parts.

19 parts = 646 bananas ⇒ 1 part = 34 bananas.

First monkey's share = 6 parts = 6 × 34 = 204 bananas.

**∴ The correct answer is 204 bananas.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total bananas = 646

Initial distribution ratio = 1/6 : 1/9 : 1/4

**Concept Used:**

To convert fractional ratios into integer ratios, multiply each term by the LCM of their denominators.

 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 Total = 646 Bananas (19 parts)

 
 6 parts
 Monkey 1
 
 
 4 parts
 Monkey 2
 
 
 9 parts
 Monkey 3
 
 1 part = 646 ÷ 19 = 34 bananas
 Monkey 1 Share = 6 × 34 = 204 bananas

**Calculations:**

⇒ The given fractions are 1/6, 1/9, and 1/4.

⇒ LCM of denominators (6, 9, 4) = 36

⇒ Multiplying each term by 36: (1/6 × 36) : (1/9 × 36) : (1/4 × 36)

⇒ Integer ratio = 6 : 4 : 9

⇒ Let the monkeys' shares be 6x, 4x, and 9x.

⇒ Total share = 6x + 4x + 9x = 19x

⇒ Total bananas = 646

⇒ 19x = 646 ⇒ x = 34

⇒ First monkey's share = 6x = 6 × 34 = 204 bananas

**∴ The correct answer is 204 bananas.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inverse Ratio

The inverse ratio of a:b is b:a. For three terms a:b:c, the inverse ratio is 1/a : 1/b : 1/c, which simplifies to bc : ac : ab.

Proportion

When two ratios are equal (a:b = c:d), they are in proportion. The product of extremes equals the product of means: a × d = b × c.

Compound Ratio

The compound ratio of two or more ratios is obtained by multiplying their antecedents together and their consequents together (e.g., ac : bd for ratios a:b and c:d).

questions.question: Mahi would need twice as much time as Neha and Asha combined, while Asha would require three times as much time as Neha and Mahi combined to complete a certain task. If all three friends work together, they can finish the task in 20 days. How many days would Neha take to complete the same task on her own?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let efficiencies be M, N, A

M takes double time of (N + A) ⇒ M = (N + A)/2

A takes triple time of (N + M) ⇒ A = (N + M)/3

Substitute ⇒ A = (3N)/5 and M = (4N)/5

Total work rate = N + M + A = (12N)/5 = 1/20 ⇒ N = 1/48

**∴ Answer = 48 days**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mahi takes twice the time of (Neha + Asha)

Asha takes three times the time of (Neha + Mahi)

All together complete work in 20 days

**Formula used:**

Efficiency ∝ 1 / Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let efficiencies be M, N, A

⇒ Mahi takes twice time ⇒ M = (N + A)/2

⇒ Asha takes three times time ⇒ A = (N + M)/3

⇒ Substitute M in second equation:

⇒ A = (N + (N + A)/2)/3

⇒ 3A = (2N + N + A)/2

⇒ 6A = 3N + A

⇒ 5A = 3N ⇒ A = 3N/5

⇒ M = (N + A)/2 = (N + 3N/5)/2 = 4N/5

⇒ Total efficiency = N + M + A = N + 4N/5 + 3N/5 = 12N/5

⇒ Given total time = 20 ⇒ efficiency = 1/20

⇒ 12N/5 = 1/20

⇒ N = 1/48

⇒ Time taken by Neha = 48 days

**∴ The correct answer is 48 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Efficiency-Time Relation

Efficiency is inversely proportional to time

Working Together

Combined efficiency = sum of individual efficiencies

Equation Formation

Convert time relations into efficiency equations

Key Insight

Solve ratios first, then apply total efficiency condition

questions.question: A dealer purchased a dryer for ₹92,000. He allows a discount of 77% on its marked price and still gains 83%. Find the marked price of the dryer.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the direct ratio formula between CP and MP:

CP : MP = (100 − D%) : (100 + P%)

CP : MP = (100 − 77) : (100 + 83) = 23 : 183

Here, 23 units = ₹92,000 ⇒ 1 unit = ₹4,000

⇒ 183 units = 183 × 4,000 = ₹7,32,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹7,32,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) = ₹92,000

Discount % (D) = 77%

Profit % (P) = 83%

**Formula Used:**

MP = CP × [(100 + P) ÷ (100 − D)]

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 CP
 
 
 
 SP
 
 
 
 MP

 
 

 +83% Profit

 
 

 −77% Discount

 
 ₹92,000
 ?

**Calculations:**

⇒ MP = 92000 × [(100 + 83) ÷ (100 − 77)]

⇒ MP = 92000 × (183 ÷ 23)

⇒ MP = 4000 × 183

⇒ MP = 7,32,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹7,32,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price (MP)

It is the price printed on the article. Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price, while Profit or Loss is calculated on the Cost Price.

Successive Discount

When two consecutive discounts of a% and b% are applied on an item, the equivalent single discount is given by: (a + b − ab ÷ 100)%.

Dishonest Dealer

A seller who claims to sell goods at cost price but uses a false weight gains a profit. Profit % = [Error ÷ (True Value − Error)] × 100.

questions.question: One pipe can fill a tank in 8 minutes, while another pipe can empty the completely filled tank in 40 minutes. If both the pipes are opened together when the tank is empty, how many minutes will it take to fill one-half of the tank?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total capacity of the tank = LCM of 8 and 40 = 40 units.

Efficiency of filling pipe = 40 ÷ 8 = +5 units/min.

Efficiency of emptying pipe = 40 ÷ 40 = −1 unit/min.

Net efficiency when both are open = 5 − 1 = 4 units/min.

Time to fill half the tank (20 units) = 20 ÷ 4 = 5 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 5 minutes.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by filling pipe = 8 minutes

Time taken by emptying pipe = 40 minutes

**Calculation:**

Let the total work (capacity) be the LCM of 8 and 40.

 
 

 **Pipe**
 **Time (min)**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 Filling Pipe
 8
 40 units
 +5
 
 

 Emptying Pipe
 40
 −1
 
 

⇒ Net efficiency of both pipes when opened together = 5 − 1 = 4 units/minute.

⇒ Total work to fill half the tank = 40 ÷ 2 = 20 units.

⇒ Time taken to fill half the tank = Target Work ÷ Net Efficiency = 20 ÷ 4 = 5 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 5 minutes.**

**__Additional Information__**

Inlet and Outlet Pipes

An inlet pipe fills the tank, so its rate of work is taken as positive. An outlet pipe empties the tank, so its rate of work is taken as negative.

Combined Rate Formula

If pipe A fills a tank in x minutes and pipe B empties it in y minutes (where y > x), the net part filled in 1 minute is (1/x − 1/y). Total time taken to completely fill the tank is (x × y) ÷ (y − x).

Alternating Pipes

When pipes are opened alternately for 1 minute each, compute the net work done in a 2-minute cycle. Care must be taken near the completion of work, as the filling pipe may fill the tank on its turn without needing the emptying pipe's turn.

questions.question: The area of a triangle is 84 cm². If the altitude corresponding to its base is two-thirds of the base length, find the length of the base.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the base of the triangle be b. The altitude is given as (2 ÷ 3) × b.

Area = 1/2 × b × altitude = 1/2 × b × (2 ÷ 3)b = b² ÷ 3

b² ÷ 3 = 84

b² = 84 × 3 = 252

b = √252 = √(36 × 7) = 6√7 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 6√7 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 

 
• 
 

 h = 2/3 b
 Base = b
 Area = 84 cm²

**Given:**

⇒ Area of the triangle = 84 cm²

⇒ Altitude (h) = 2/3 of Base (b)

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Area of a triangle = 1/2 × Base × Altitude

**Calculations:**

⇒ 84 = 1/2 × b × (2/3 × b)

⇒ 84 = 1/3 × b²

⇒ b² = 84 × 3

⇒ b² = 252

⇒ b = √252

⇒ b = √(36 × 7)

⇒ b = 6√7 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 6√7 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Equilateral Triangle Area

For a triangle with all sides equal to 'a', Area = (√3 ÷ 4) × a² and Height = (√3 ÷ 2) × a.

Heron's Formula for Any Triangle

If sides are a, b, and c with semi-perimeter s = (a + b + c) ÷ 2, Area = √[s × (s − a) × (s − b) × (s − c)].

Right Angled Triangle

Area = 1/2 × Base × Perpendicular, where the base and perpendicular are the sides adjacent to the 90-degree angle.
</p

questions.question: If the mean proportional of X and 125 is 25, then find the value of X.5773

First term = (Mean Proportional)² ÷ Third term

First term = 25² ÷ 125

First term = 625 ÷ 125 = 5

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First term (a) = X

Third term (c) = 125

Mean proportional (b) = 25

 
 X
 First Term

 
 25
 Mean Prop.

 
 125
 Third Term

 

 

 25² = X × 125

**Formula Used:**

The relation for mean proportional b between a and c is: b² = a × c

**Calculations:**

⇒ 25² = X × 125

⇒ 625 = 125X

⇒ X = 625 ÷ 125

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is given by √(a × b).

Third Proportional

If a : b :: b : c, then c is the third proportional to a and b. It is calculated as c = b² ÷ a.

Fourth Proportional

If a : b :: c : d, then d is the fourth proportional to a, b, and c. It is calculated as d = (b × c) ÷ a.

questions.question: The arithmetic mean of the observations 29, 90, 50, 26, 36, 77, 86, 33 and 41 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the Assumed Mean Method (Deviation Method). Let the Assumed Mean = 50.

Deviations from 50 = −21, +40, 0, −24, −14, +27, +36, −17, −9.

Sum of deviations = (+40 + 27 + 36) − (21 + 24 + 14 + 17 + 9) = 103 − 85 = +18.

Average deviation = +18 ÷ 9 = +2.

Actual Mean = Assumed Mean + Average deviation = 50 + 2 = 52.

**∴ The correct answer is 52.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Observations = 29, 90, 50, 26, 36, 77, 86, 33, 41

Total number of observations (n) = 9

**Formula Used:**

Arithmetic Mean = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations)

 
• 

 
 29

 
 90

 
 50

 
 26

 
 36

 
 77

 
 86

 
 33

 
 41

 
• 
 Mean = 52
 
 Sum = 468 | N = 9 | Mean = 468 ÷ 9 = 52

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of observations = 29 + 90 + 50 + 26 + 36 + 77 + 86 + 33 + 41

⇒ Sum of observations = 468

⇒ Arithmetic Mean = 468 ÷ 9

⇒ Arithmetic Mean = 52

**∴ The correct answer is 52.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Mean

It is the simplest and most widely used measure of an average. It involves finding the sum of a given group of values and then dividing that sum by the total count of numbers.

Assumed Mean Method

This method is highly useful in reducing calculations for large data groups. Formula: Actual Mean = Assumed Mean + (Sum of Deviations ÷ Number of Observations).

Weighted Average

Used when certain data points hold more weight or frequency. Formula: Weighted Mean = Σ(wᵢ × xᵢ) ÷ Σwᵢ.

Empirical Relationship

For moderately skewed distributions, the mean, median, and mode are fundamentally related by the formula: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.
</p

questions.question: The sum of the present ages of A and B is 42 years. After 6 years, A will be twice as old as B. Find B's present age.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let B = x ⇒ A = 42 − x

After 6 years: A + 6 = 2(B + 6)

42 − x + 6 = 2x + 12

48 − x = 2x + 12 ⇒ 36 = 3x ⇒ x = 12

**∴ Answer = 12 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of present ages of A and B = 42

After 6 years, A = 2 × B

**Formula used:**

Age relation equations

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let B's present age = x

⇒ A's present age = 42 − x

⇒ After 6 years:

⇒ A + 6 = 2(B + 6)

⇒ (42 − x) + 6 = 2(x + 6)

⇒ 48 − x = 2x + 12

⇒ 48 − 12 = 3x

⇒ 36 = 3x

⇒ x = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Equation Concept

Translate word statements into algebraic equations

Future Age Rule

After n years, age increases by n for all persons

Linear Equation

Solve equations of the form ax + b = cx + d

Verification

Check by substituting values into original condition

questions.question: A man is walking at a speed of 12 km/hr. After every kilometre of walk, he takes a rest for 7 minutes. How much time (in minutes) will he take to cover a distance of 6 km?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed = 12 km/hr ⇒ 1 km in 5 minutes

For 6 km ⇒ walking time = 6 × 5 = 30 minutes

Rest after every km except last ⇒ 5 rests

Total rest = 5 × 7 = 35 minutes

Total time = 30 + 35 = 65 minutes

**∴ Answer = 65 minutes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed = 12 km/hr, Rest after each km = 7 minutes

Total distance = 6 km

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Time to cover 1 km = 60 ÷ 12 = 5 minutes

⇒ Time to cover 6 km = 6 × 5 = 30 minutes

⇒ Number of rests = 6 − 1 = 5

⇒ Total rest time = 5 × 7 = 35 minutes

⇒ Total time = 30 + 35 = 65 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 65 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed Conversion

km/hr to min/km: divide 60 by speed

Rest Concept

No rest after completing final distance

Total Time

Total time = walking time + rest time

Shortcut Insight

Number of rests = number of segments − 1

questions.question: If 20% of a number is added to 84, then the result is the same number. 75% of the same number is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The total number always represents 100%.

Since adding 20% to 84 gives the full 100%, the value 84 must represent 80% of the number.

We need to find 75% of the same number.

Required Value = (84 ÷ 80) × 75 = 1.05 × 75 = 78.75

**∴ The correct answer is 78.75.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

20% of a number + 84 = The same number

**Formula Used:**

Total Number = 100%

 
 
 
 20%
 Added Value = 84 (80% part)
 
 

 Total Number (100%) = 105

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the number be x.

⇒ 20% of x + 84 = x

⇒ 84 = x − 20% of x

⇒ 84 = 100% of x − 20% of x

⇒ 84 = 80% of x

⇒ x = (84 × 100) ÷ 80

⇒ x = 8400 ÷ 80 = 105

⇒ Now, we need to find 75% of the same number (x).

⇒ 75% of 105 = (75 ÷ 100) × 105

⇒ 75% of 105 = 0.75 × 105 = 78.75

**∴ The correct answer is 78.75.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Base Rule

In any percentage calculation, the original or total quantity is always considered as the 100% base value.

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

To simplify percentage calculations, convert them into fractions by dividing the percentage value by 100 (e.g., 75% = 75 ÷ 100 = 3/4).

Percentage Change

Percentage change is calculated using the formula: ((Final Value − Initial Value) ÷ Initial Value) × 100.
</p

questions.question: A cricketer has an average of 97 runs over 6 innings. If he scores 231 runs in the 7th inning, by how many runs (rounded off to the nearest whole number) does his average score increase?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Initial total = 97 × 6 = 582

New total = 582 + 231 = 813

New average = 813 ÷ 7 ≈ 116.14

Increase = 116.14 − 97 ≈ 19.14 ≈ 19

**∴ Answer = 19 runs**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 6 innings = 97

Runs in 7th inning = 231

**Formula used:**

Average = Total runs ÷ Number of innings

questions.question: Find the value of (2.99)².
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

We can solve this quickly using the algebraic identity: (a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b²

Express the decimal 2.99 as (3 − 0.01).

⇒ (3 − 0.01)² = 3² − 2 × 3 × 0.01 + (0.01)²

⇒ 9 − 0.06 + 0.0001 = 8.9401

**∴ The correct answer is 8.9401.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: (2.99)²

**Formula Used:**

(a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b²

**Calculations:**

⇒ Convert the given decimal into a fraction to avoid decimal calculation errors.

⇒ 2.99 = 299 ÷ 100

⇒ (2.99)² = (299 ÷ 100)² = 299² ÷ 10000

⇒ To easily find 299², we can write it as (300 − 1)²

⇒ 299² = 300² − 2 × 300 × 1 + 1²

⇒ 299² = 90000 − 600 + 1

⇒ 299² = 89401

⇒ Now, divide by 10000 to restore the decimal places.

⇒ 89401 ÷ 10000 = 8.9401

**∴ The correct answer is 8.9401.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Identities

Standard identities like (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b² and a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b) are extremely helpful for mental math and speeding up large calculations.

Decimal Multiplication Rules

When squaring a decimal, the number of decimal places in the final result is exactly twice the number of decimal places in the original base number. Since 2.99 has 2 decimal places, its square will have 4 decimal places.

Simplification Basics

Converting decimals to fractions (e.g., 2.99 to 299 ÷ 100) often reduces silly mistakes when working with squares, cubes, and higher exponent powers.
</p

questions.question:
Simplify the algebraic expression.

 a²(a + 2) – 3a (a² – 3) – 5a (a + 5)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Put a = 1 in the given expression to quickly find the right option.

Given: a²(a + 2) − 3a(a² − 3) − 5a(a + 5)

⇒ 1(1 + 2) − 3(1)(1 − 3) − 5(1)(1 + 5)

⇒ 3 + 6 − 30 = −21

Now put a = 1 in the options. Only Option 1 gives: −2 − 3 − 16 = −21.

**∴ The correct answer is −2a³ − 3a² − 16a.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

a²(a + 2) − 3a(a² − 3) − 5a(a + 5)

**Calculation:**

Expand each term by multiplying:

⇒ (a² × a + a² × 2) − (3a × a² − 3a × 3) − (5a × a + 5a × 5)

⇒ a³ + 2a² − 3a³ + 9a − 5a² − 25a

Group the like terms together (a³, a², and a):

⇒ (a³ − 3a³) + (2a² − 5a²) + (9a − 25a)

⇒ −2a³ − 3a² − 16a

**∴ The correct answer is −2a³ − 3a² − 16a.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

Always follow BODMAS (Brackets, Orders, Division/Multiplication, Addition/Subtraction) to evaluate algebraic expressions to avoid sign errors while opening brackets.

Value Putting Strategy

For multiple choice polynomial simplification questions, substituting a simple integer value like 1, −1, or 2 into the expression and the options can quickly verify the correct algebraic answer.

questions.question: A man buys magazines in bulk for ₹20 each. He sells them for ₹23 each. Find the profit percentage.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Cost Price (CP) to Selling Price (SP) = 20 : 23

Profit in terms of ratio parts = 23 − 20 = 3 parts

Profit % = (Profit parts ÷ CP parts) × 100

⇒ Profit % = (3 ÷ 20) × 100 = 15%

**∴ The correct answer is 15%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) of the magazine = ₹20

Selling Price (SP) of the magazine = ₹23

**Formula Used:**

Profit = SP − CP

Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100

 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 CP = ₹20
 
 
• 
 + ₹3 (Profit)
 
 
 SP = ₹23
 
 Profit % = (3 / 20) × 100 = 15%

**Calculations:**

⇒ Profit = 23 − 20

⇒ Profit = ₹3

⇒ Profit % = (3 ÷ 20) × 100

⇒ Profit % = 3 × 5

⇒ Profit % = 15%

**∴ The correct answer is 15%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Loss Percentage

If Cost Price > Selling Price, a loss occurs. Loss % = (Loss ÷ CP) × 100. Both profit and loss are always calculated on the base Cost Price (CP) unless explicitly stated otherwise.

Marked Price & Discount

Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price (MP). SP = MP − Discount. Discount % = (Discount ÷ MP) × 100.

Dishonest Dealer

When a dealer uses false weights to cheat the customer, his true Profit % is calculated using the formula: Profit % = (True Weight − False Weight) ÷ False Weight × 100.
</p

questions.question: Three-fourth of a number exceeds its two-fifth by 63. What is the number?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the number be the LCM of the denominators 4 and 5, which is 20 units.

3/4 of the number = 15 units.

2/5 of the number = 8 units.

Difference = 15 units − 8 units = 7 units.

7 units = 63 ⇒ 1 unit = 9.

**∴ The correct answer is 180.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Three-fourth of a number exceeds its two-fifth by 63.

 
 3/4 of Total (15 units)

 
 2/5 (8 units)

 
 Total Number (20 units)

 
• 
 
• 
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 Diff: 7 units = 63
 
 1 unit = 9 → 20 units = 180

**Calculations:**

Let the required number be x.

⇒ (3/4)x − (2/5)x = 63

⇒ (15x − 8x) / 20 = 63

⇒ 7x / 20 = 63

⇒ x = (63 × 20) / 7

⇒ x = 9 × 20 = 180

**∴ The correct answer is 180.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fractional Equivalence (LCM Method)

To simplify calculations involving multiple fractions, assume the total base value as the Lowest Common Multiple (LCM) of all the denominators involved. This completely avoids decimal and fraction additions.

Algebraic Translation

Terms like exceeds, difference, or more than mathematically translate to a direct subtraction between the given entities in linear equations.

questions.question: {Simplify: } (sqrt{75} - sqrt{108} + sqrt{6075})²
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Factor out perfect squares to express all terms as multiples of √3.

√75 = 5√3, √108 = 6√3, √6075 = 45√3

Expression = (5√3 − 6√3 + 45√3)²

Sum inside bracket = 44√3

Square the sum = (44√3)² = 1936 × 3 = 5808

**∴ The correct answer is 5808.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(√75 − √108 + √6075)²

**Calculations:**

⇒ Simplifying each surd independently:

⇒ √75 = √(25 × 3) = 5√3

⇒ √108 = √(36 × 3) = 6√3

⇒ √6075 = √(2025 × 3) = 45√3

⇒ Substituting the simplified surds back into the expression:

⇒ (5√3 − 6√3 + 45√3)²

⇒ Grouping the terms together:

⇒ [(5 − 6 + 45)√3]²

⇒ [44√3]²

⇒ Squaring both parts inside the bracket:

⇒ 44² × (√3)²

⇒ 1936 × 3 = 5808

**∴ The correct answer is 5808.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Surds

The multiplication property √(a × b) = √a × √b helps extract perfect squares to simplify complex roots easily.

Perfect Squares

Memorising squares of numbers up to 50 is extremely useful. For example, knowing 45² = 2025 instantly identifies √6075 as 45√3.

BODMAS / PEMDAS Rule

Always simplify the operations inside the Brackets first before applying the exponent (power of 2) to the overall expression.
</p

questions.question: A dealer marks his goods at 29% above the cost price and allows a discount of 7% on the marked price. What is his gain or loss percentage?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net multiplier = (1 + 29%) × (1 − 7%)

= 1.29 × 0.93 = 1.1997

Gain = (1.1997 − 1) × 100 = 19.97%

**∴ Answer = 19.97% gain**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked price = 29% above cost price

Discount = 7%

**Formula used:**

SP = CP × (1 + mark%) × (1 − discount%)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let CP = 100

⇒ MP = 100 × 1.29 = 129

⇒ SP = 129 × 0.93 = 119.97

⇒ Gain = 119.97 − 100 = 19.97

⇒ Gain% = 19.97%

**∴ The correct answer is 19.97% gain.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage

Net effect = (1 + a)(1 − b)

Profit Formula

Profit% = (SP − CP) ÷ CP × 100

Assumption Method

Assume CP = 100 for easy calculation

Key Insight

Always combine markup and discount multiplicatively
